description: Protect /merge-pr's gate: it merges when CI already passed on the exact head commit (all runs success, nothing outside Actions failing, not BLOCKED), or only when no CI job ran a step (Actions could not start) or the repository has no CI at all, after the workflow's own run: steps, or with no CI the project's declared checks, pass in a clean worktree on the exact head commit, with the review signed off; a job that ran and failed goes to /ship-pr, and a no-CI repository is handled here, not sent to /ship-pr.
must_contain: for every run, no job executed a step
If any job ran a step and failed, stop
git worktree add --detach <scratch>/merge-pr-<n> <sha>
**Never pipe or chain a check into anything that hides its exit code**
If a **required** check can't be reproduced
**Review sign-off still applies.**
gh pr merge <n> --merge --delete-branch --match-head-commit <sha>
Merging when any CI job actually ran and failed, or while runs are still pending.
**The repository has no CI.** This case holds only when **all** of these are true:

don't
send them to `/ship-pr`

a diff review alone isn't
evidence for a merge
**CI already passed.** This case holds only when **all** of these are true:

every run's conclusion is
  `success`
the runs must be for `<sha>`.
**Read the checks outside Actions in every case.**

Any failing or pending entry that isn't one of the Actions jobs listed
above stops the run.
**Stop on `mergeStateStatus` `BLOCKED`.**
**Do the one infrastructure rerun first** (`gh run rerun <id>`), and never more than one.

a job that ran and failed means stop, a real failure for
`/ship-pr`.
the same cause failed a run on another recent commit
every run is `completed`. Pending or queued runs mean wait
